dispatch_policy.arrival_rate: saturated dispatch bounded by free client slots; no fixed open-loop rate is claimed; measure observed offered and completed requests per second
dispatch_policy.arrival_profile: next sealed request dispatched immediately when a client slot is free; no fixed external arrival rate is claimed; record observed offered rate and completion rate
dispatch_policy.server_auto_tokenize_or_reorder: must be disabled or exact returned token IDs and order must match the sealed request manifest

measurement_order.per_repetition: warm-up requests first using WU-<workload>-R<rep>-<index>; then measured unique requests in frozen manifest order; drain all requests before next repetition
measurement_order.failure_policy: preserve failed request and denominator; never replace automatically

resource_monitor_interface.provider: trusted provider must return timestamped GPU identity, owner-scoped exclusive-lock identity, physical free/used HBM and disk free bytes
resource_monitor_interface.termination_scope: only the explicitly owned benchmark child process tree after separate execution approval; never terminate unrelated processes or services
resource_monitor_interface.cpu_validator_guarantee: record-shape and threshold checks only; no reservation, live observation, watchdog, or execution authority

independent_unit.condition: one complete workload condition W1 or W2
independent_unit.request_source_unit: one uniquely identified measured request; warm-up IDs are separate and excluded from measured n
independent_unit.repeated_measurement_unit: one repetition per condition; report all three repetitions separately
independent_unit.independence_caveat: request identities and repetition count do not establish independent model runs or support unsupported tail claims

readiness_checklist: R0-B0 request/source/tokenizer manifests generated only after separate approval and sealed; SHA256 readback verified
server-side token IDs and lengths exactly match sealed requests in order; no hidden retokenization/reorder
vLLM exact version/commit and every worker/layer backend+implementation identity are source-pinned and observed
dedicated GPU ownership and lock are independently established by a trusted live provider
resource monitor/watchdog tested with mocks and bound only to an owned child process tree
legacy evidence tree and active repository contracts revalidated
W1/W2 workload, arrival policy, metrics, SLO interpretation and failure denominator receive scientific approval
researcher explicitly approves R0-B1 GPU use and the bounded wall-time budget
